title: Eco Green Solar CMS v2.5.1
summary: Fix Complaint Edit Type Error & Mobile-First Authentication with Admin-Only Password Management
features: 🛠️ Ticket Edit Fix: Resolved integer type casting error when updating complaint warranty and charge notification flags.
📱 Mobile-First Authentication: Streamlined login and team management to strictly use Mobile Number and Password, removing redundant User ID / Username fields.
🔒 Admin-Only Password Control: Strictly restricted password change and reset permissions to Administrators only across both backend APIs and UI controls.
